<!-- pr-reviewer: 8f75bb9c60f4af3de7e0b1585720bbcc557b6677 -->
Verdict: clean - merge-ready. A one-line test-file fix for a red `wire_post` build, green on the runner.

What looks good:
- The fix is one line in `crates/app/tests/wire_post/model_arcs.rs` (`die_of`, the `WireContourOp` initializer): `lead_arc_radius: None,` - the straight-lead default, exactly what #4058 asks.
- The value matches the default every other test initializer sets (`agie_native.rs`, `g_edm_post.rs`, `sodick_alc400g.rs`, `setup_align_non_mill.rs`, and the rest). No initializer of the struct is left without the field.
- No runtime code, no assertion changes, no golden changes.

Results merged with main `c92b6c3fc0e08899381a79b8da0d75c79ddb481e`, on the self-hosted runner (run <https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45691050916>, head 8f75bb9c60f4):
- Trial merge with main: success (merged: true).
- Quick gate: `app wire_post (model_arcs::)` - ok, 41 s (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_post -- model_arcs::`).
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` - pass.

The runner checks only its own OS's arm of Windows-only readings. The diff adds no `cfg(windows)`, no per-OS pinned value, so no local re-run is owed.

Targeted tests (step 5):
- No post or toolpath change, so no example catalog suites run.
- P2 (a red `main` build), not a safety-floor change: no targeted heavy step.
- Light lane: not run. The diff reaches no heavy lane (the touched file holds no `_light` twin; the only twins live in `motion` and `pocket_pass_start.rs`). A local `gate light` release build is not started, per this host's one-review-build limit and the runner-first rule - it belongs to the cut gate. No runtime code changed, so the lane would not exercise this fix.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):
- PR #4063 is a duplicate of this fix (same field, a different initializer line, same issue family). Only one of the two PRs can merge: together they give a duplicate `lead_arc_radius`, and the build breaks again. Merge only this one. (No comment made and no labels set on #4063.)

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
